summary: Gyomu Infrastructure is a core foundational package providing robust utility modules and infrastructure components for CSV data processing, file system management, stream handling, database interactions via SQLAlchemy, and business calendar calculations.
responsibilities: Provide foundational infrastructure utilities for data serialization, file system manipulation, and stream processing.
Implement database access patterns, connection management, and entity mapping.
Support core business domain services such as date calculations and parameter management.

capabilities.name: CSV Data Processing
capabilities.description: Parse, serialize, and validate CSV data using Pydantic models with customizable parsing and formatting options.

capabilities.name: Filesystem Utilities
capabilities.description: Perform file I/O operations, text and JSON manipulation, directory management, and file searching.

capabilities.name: Stream Processing
capabilities.description: Process lazy single-use streams and handle byte stream file writing operations.

capabilities.name: Database Access and ORM
capabilities.description: Manage database connectivity, transactions, repositories, and object mapping via SQLAlchemy.

capabilities.name: Business Calendar and Dates
capabilities.description: Calculate business calendars and manage holiday-dependent domain logic.

design_decisions: Leverages Pydantic for robust data validation and schema definition across CSV processing and database mapping.
Employs SQLAlchemy protocol-based repository patterns and transaction managers for database abstraction.
Integrates functional programming constructs like Result values for lazy stream processing.
usage_guidance: Use the CSV reader and writer components with Pydantic models for structured data import and export.
Utilize SQLAlchemy-based repositories and transaction managers for persistent data operations.
Leverage filesystem and stream utilities for secure file handling, searching, and lazy data processing.
